text:
Samira Khan: Heads-up 44b Candidate is internal transfer (L5 IC) from EMEA to US. Offer includes $15k signing, $5k relocation, and manager asked for $2k gross-up on the relocation because of visa tax exposure. Proposed start 2026-06-01. Can people-ops route approvals?

Nate Li: @Samira please confirm comp band (base + equity) and whether this triggers a comp-band exception or just a FY reband. Also need manager justification for gross-up.

Samira Khan: Base 160k, eq 40k unvested, comp band L5. Manager notes transfer + visa admin cost; requesting gross-up on $2k only. Attaching short justification in candidate record.

Priya Desai: Benefits-Team here 4c8 For 06-01 start, carrier A enrolls first of month, carrier B needs 2-week lead. If transfer crosses countries we need to confirm benefit waiting periods. Option: keep 06-01 and offer a one-time health bridge of $250.

Payroll-bot: Reminder: any gross-up must be processed in a taxable payroll event. Provide GL code and tax reason code. Example payload:

```
employee: "Candidate Name",
start_date: "2026-06-01",
grossup_amount: 2000,
gl_code: "GROSSUP_RELO_2026",
pay_event: "signing_bonus_grossup"
```

Samira Khan: Manager also asked if we can frontload 2 days PTO in June to cover onboarding travel. Prefer not to change official start. Thoughts?

Nate Li: Frontload PTO OK from comp perspective for one-off. Approver chain: hiring manager -> people ops lead -> payroll. No permanent band change so comp committee not needed.

Benefits-Team: Confirmed: $250 bridge or enroll on 06-01 depending on carrier. If candidate wants earlier coverage, bridge is easiest. We'll draft offer language.

Recruiter-bot: Offer created: offer-8021 (status: pending approvals). Link: https://recruiter.internal/offers/8021

Samira Khan: Action items: (1) Samira to upload comp justification + add gross-up line to offer docs, (2) Nate to route gross-up approval to People Ops Lead, (3) Payroll-bot to accept GL code once provided, (4) Benefits-Team to attach bridge language for offer.

Priya Desai: Draft bridge wording: "We will provide a one-time $250 health-bridge stipend if your carrier enrollment start date is after your first day. This stipend is taxable and paid on your first payroll run." Will finalize after carrier confirmation.

Nate Li: @Samira pls ping me the justification doc. I'll get People Ops Lead to approve the PTO frontload and gross-up routing.

Samira Khan: Uploaded justification now. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Candidate (via Recruiter): prefer 06-01 and bridge stipend, ok with PTO frontload if needed.

Payroll-bot: Noted. Waiting for GL code and approval chain to complete before scheduling tax event.

Samira Khan: Closing note: we'll avoid moving start date. Frontload PTO + $250 bridge + $2k gross-up on relocation looks like the path. Will update offer to pending-approved once finance signs off.
